# Negotiation Memo: Prairie National Bank Account Analysis Review

**To:** Treasurer
**From:** Treasury Analyst
**Re:** Fee findings and negotiation asks, Oct 2025 to Sep 2026

## Relationship overview

Across 12 accounts, average collected balance is $4,134,808, against $4,013,855 required to offset fees. Annual fees are $110,260 and annual earnings credit is $113,595 (ECR 2.75%), leaving net cash charges of $2,403. Idle-cash income opportunity is $0. That is investment income, not a fee saving, so it is kept separate below.

Findings total $2,765.37 in one-time refunds (past overcharges) and $10,832 in annual fee savings (going forward).

## Top issues

- **Unannounced price increases (Jul 2026):** Six services rose in July while the bank's price schedule still shows the old prices. The largest are Outgoing Domestic Wire - Online ($11.290 to $12.760, $3,610/year) and Incoming Domestic Wire ($11.780 to $13.870, $2,174/year). The other four are BAI Prior-Day Detail Item ($965/year), Positive Pay Maintenance ($646/year), ACH Received Item ($548/year), and ZBA Sub Account Maintenance ($400/year).
- **Duplicate charges (one-time):** Outgoing Domestic Wire - Online on PNB-0003 was billed twice in Nov 2025 ($2,111.23 refund). ACH File Transmission on PNB-0011 was billed twice in May 2026 ($57.00 refund).
- **Tier pricing misapplied (one-time):** ACH Originated Credit was billed at $0.110 instead of the Tier 2 rate of $0.075 for Dec 2025 to Feb 2026 ($597.14 refund).
- **Unused service billed:** Positive Pay Maintenance on PNB-0007 was billed for 7 months with no related activity. $475.66 was billed while unused, and the ongoing charge is $889/year.
- **Above-benchmark pricing:** ACH File Transmission is at $19.000 and Stop Payment at $36.000. Benchmarks are illustrative, not market survey data. Reaching the illustrative p75 would save $1,456/year on ACH and $144/year on Stop Payment.

## Specific asks

1. Refund $2,111.23 (PNB-0003 duplicate wire) and $57.00 (PNB-0011 duplicate ACH file), and confirm the billing fix in writing.
2. Refund the $597.14 ACH Originated Credit tier difference and correct the tier setup.
3. Provide the July 2026 price-change notices, roll back the six services to contracted prices, and credit the Jul to Sep 2026 overbilling.
4. Cancel Positive Pay Maintenance on PNB-0007 (or close the account if it is no longer needed) and credit the $475.66 billed while unused.
5. Reprice ACH File Transmission to no more than $15.00 and Stop Payment to no more than $32.00.

## Fallback positions

- If the bank will not roll back all six price increases, prioritize the two wire increases ($3,610 and $2,174/year).
- Accept the p75 price ($15.00 ACH file, $32.00 Stop Payment) instead of the median target ($10.00 and $25.00).
- If the bank refuses cash refunds, accept fee credits equal to the full $2,765.37, but not less.
- If PNB-0007 still needs Positive Pay, keep the module at minimum and insist on the $475.66 credit.

## Suggested next step and timing

Send the findings to the relationship manager this week. Request the July 2026 price-change notices and written billing corrections first, since they confirm the overcharges before any repricing discussion. Hold the one-time refunds and the annual savings in separate columns in the negotiation, and keep idle-cash income out of the fee totals.
